name: Virginity
overview: Scripture upholds virginity as a sacred state prior to marriage, emphasizing purity and honor in the marital relationship. From creation, God instituted male and female to unite as one flesh in marriage (Genesis 2:24; Mark 10:6), where the marriage bed is to remain undefiled (Hebrews 13:4). The redeemed who remain undefiled are described as virgins who follow Christ faithfully (Revelation 14:4), underscoring the value of sexual purity before marriage. Believers are called to present their bodies as holy and acceptable to God (Romans 12:1), living in obedience to His design for marriage and virginity.
